assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only shokugeki-no-soma:nakiri-senzaemon@manga#reviewed-dedicated-analysis, the active_provisional V2 bounded character model SHOKUGEKI_SENZAEMON_CHARACTER_MODEL.md (13,517 bytes) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese manga V01-V36 including Le dessert. Its linked deep readings (D01, D16, D17, D23, D29, D31, D36), state, voice, relationship and readiness ledgers, evidence matrix, router and validation and fidelity audits are not curated on this subject and were not used as evidence. The model's readiness label 'substantial, provisional' and its authority_state are inputs, not conclusions. No anime adaptation or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Six states as the model orders them: the opening patriarch who overrides gatekeeping to admit Soma (D01); the witness to Jōichirō's collapse who permits his withdrawal (D23); the displaced elder during Central who asks Soma to help Erina (D16, D17); the Régiment procedural authority who reshapes the final into one paired course (D29); post-Central succession to Erina (D31); and the terminal revelation of the Jewel Generation's protective design (D36), which the model makes its default when time is unspecified. The record covers every state; in each it excludes his response to an objection to his arrangements and any ordinary private conduct. Evidence is located by volume reading key and VV-NNN archive image, not by chapter-level state change; the serialized ending, Présent, Passé and Futur are kept distinct by the model. The terminal revelation explains a strategy he already held; it does not establish foresight of every later friendship, loss or refusal.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives a governing thesis (he can perceive that a gifted cook needs a sustaining world rather than another compulsory summit, and governs through exceptional discretion, attrition, family authority and covert arrangement), four values (culinary excellence, institutional continuity, the Nakiri future, protection of gifted people from isolation), a named blind spot (the legitimacy of arranging others' lives through concentrated power), rejected reductions (omniscient benevolent strategist, empty ceremonial elder) and a seven-row decision policy, six rows rated H. Not B: the model states that the same values support opposed methods (severe attrition, a stopping gesture, covert recruitment) and that he does not resolve them; it cannot say when protective care overrides severe selection before a collapse is visible (his permission to Jōichirō came late), and his response when a beneficiary objects to an arrangement is U (probe 2). Which of his competing motives decides a new case is undecided, not a matter of wording, and it sits at the centre of his character. Not D: each located intervention is explained by an H trigger, an action and a stated bound.

A six-row state table gives the authority exercised in each state and what stays separate, from the opening override through Jōichirō's withdrawal, the Central-era appeal, Régiment procedure and succession to the terminal revelation, with volume keys. Not B: the states are defined by successive interventions rather than by a change in him; the model says he is longitudinal through distinct interventions but sparse in ordinary behavior, and no change in his practice after the late recognition of Jōichirō's crisis is shown. Not D: each state carries a distinct authority, a stated limit and located keys.

The model describes his speech as formal, ceremonial, evaluative and capable of authoritative finality, and gives one discriminating condition: public selection language differs from a concrete appeal for someone's welfare, and a personal plea or stopping gesture changes the relation without erasing his status. Not C: it locates no forms or lines, forbids an unverified archaic pronoun, stock grandfather ending or aphorism, and defers exact forms to a voice ledger that is not curated on this subject. Not E: the public-versus-appeal condition discriminates between occasions.

The model affirmatively states that his ordinary-life evidence is narrow: ceremonial tasting, family interventions, institutional presence and retirement reveal no detailed private routine; a bodily reaction to excellent food establishes a sensory effect, not hobbies, favorite dishes or a comic temperament; the appropriate baseline is explicit sparsity, and a quiet scene may keep only formal authority and concern for a concrete person. Not D: no ordinary conduct beyond those institutional occasions is located.

The model distinguishes his conduct by recipient and gives the reason: with Jōichirō he eventually recognizes that continuing is itself the problem and permits an exit; with Soma he lowers ceremonial distance to ask for help; with Erina he both protects and places a hereditary burden within a planned ecology; with Azami he contests control through the same concentrated authority; with the recruited cohort his plan creates opportunity while treating their formation instrumentally; unknown students do not inherit the intimacy of his family appeals. Bounds are stated: Soma does not own Erina's recovery, and the cohort's friendships do not ratify the covert arrangement. Not A: each relation rests on a single located intervention, and no relation shows his response to an objection. Not C: the account says what changes his response from recipient to recipient and where it stops.

Interior evidence is inferred from conduct: concern routed into exceptional intervention or a direct appeal, protective fear routed into a covert system, institutional pride into severe selection rhetoric, and the terminal explanation of the protective rationale. The model states that anger, grief, humor and mild frustration outside these routes lack comparable breadth. Not C: no interior state of his is located apart from the action it explains. Not E: the routes from concern and fear to located interventions are stated.

Conflict is located in institutional form: overriding gatekeeping to admit Soma (D01), seeking outside help for Erina and supporting a contest route against Azami's control (D16, D17), changing the final into a paired course (D29) and retiring to transfer office (D31). The model bounds each: an override is not a fair appeals system, format authority does not erase interested judging, succession is not democratic refounding. Not B: his personal conduct in confrontation is not described beyond these procedural acts, and his response to a recruited peer's objection is U (probe 2). Not D: the institutional conflict routes are located with conditions and exceptions.

Located material: the terminal explanation of the protective rationale for covert recruitment (D36), the late permission for Jōichirō to stop (D23), and the model's statement that practical success does not establish informed consent and that a general pattern of accepting refusal or revising an arrangement after an objection is not shown. Probe 2 supports explaining the rationale while preserving the objection; whether he apologizes, defends the plan or changes future admissions is U. Not C: the model shows a rationale given after the fact, not a weighing of others' consent against his protective aim. Not E: the rationale and its unconsented consequences are located.

The model establishes no humor of his. It states that humor outside his evidenced routes lacks breadth, that a bodily reaction to food does not establish an everyday comic temperament, and forbids manufacturing grandfatherly laughter or a humor routine (probe 3); these are recorded as an evidence-backed limit, not as a grade.

The model draws on the complete V2 reading, keys its rules to seven volume readings, marks supplementary comics as lower weight, excludes defective or obscured images (26-137, 36-114, 36-258) and names its material gaps (his own cooking, daily private life, repeated ordinary criticism and repair, beneficiaries' informed consent, full accountability). Not B: it is a compact consolidation through analytical retrieval, its readings and ledgers are outside this evidence set, and the evaluator could not recheck any locator. Not D: each rule carries a located reading key.

Affirmative controls: his late recognition of Jōichirō's crisis is counterevidence against omniscience; the Jewel Generation exceed the roles assigned to them, so calling them his pieces repeats a reduction the source complicates; his own authored cooking is not comparably shown, so judging food does not establish chef mastery; the revelation does not document an admission or correction of his failures; succession shows no democratic redesign. Not B: several controls are analytic prohibitions (no chessmaster foreknowledge, no all-caring grandfather) rather than source facts. Not D: the source-fact controls are specific and decisive where they apply.

Rules are tied to named states and reading keys, the terminal revelation is kept separate from foresight of later events, and the serialized ending and Le dessert parts are kept distinct. Not B: locators are volume-reading keys rather than chapter or page ranges, and the period between interventions is not modeled.

conditions: Translated illustrative lines only, never presented as quotation, in a located occasion: a ceremonial or public evaluation, a selection or procedural pronouncement, or a concrete welfare appeal or permission (asking Soma for help, permitting Jōichirō to stop).
Register follows the model: formal, ceremonial and evaluative, with authoritative finality in public; a personal plea changes the relation without erasing his status.
No Japanese pronoun or ending inventory, no archaic pronoun, stock grandfather ending or aphorism added to sound old, and no audiovisual performance claims.
No line that jokes, apologizes for the covert recruitment, admits foresight of every outcome or describes a private routine.
scenario_readiness.note: The model constrains function and pragmatics enough for short illustrative lines in located occasions, not for Japanese forms, which it defers to an uncurated voice ledger.

conditions: A novel case in which a known gifted person's continuation, admission or future is threatened by gatekeeping, expectation, family control or isolation; he acts by changing conditions around them (an override, a permission, enlisting others, a procedural change), and may recognize the problem late.

An unfamiliar student who cannot bear another public competition: permission to withdraw is plausible when inability is visible, but early recognition is not guaranteed (probe 1, M); the student does not inherit his family intimacy.
The interlocutor is Jōichirō, Soma, Erina, Azami or a recruited peer; any other recipient is a separate, lower-confidence case.
Abstain on his response when a beneficiary objects to an arrangement (probe 2, U), apology or reform of admissions, his own cooking, ordinary preferences, humor and foreknowledge of outcomes.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: A named state from the opening patriarch through the Central-era appeal, Régiment procedure, succession and the terminal revelation; in the retired state, only formal authority and concern for a concrete person, with no private routine.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Jōichirō as a former prodigy he permitted to stop, Soma as an outsider he asks for help, Erina as the family heir he both protects and burdens, Azami as the paternal authority whose institutional control he contests, or a recruited peer; an unknown student only as a separate, lower-confidence case.
setting_constraints: The school's institutional settings: admissions, competitions, judging, succession and family intervention.
No domestic, leisure or comic setting and no anime adaptation material.
Culinary mechanism, judging and institutions follow their specialist routes, which are outside this evidence set.

scenario_readiness.note: Narrow extrapolation within the institutional and family interventions the model samples; his response to objection and his ordinary conduct are excluded.

The model says his ordinary-life evidence is narrow, that a quiet scene cannot confidently specify domestic chores, embarrassment, leisurely conversation or routine apology, and that the baseline is explicit sparsity; an unfamiliar family guest's minor correction is U (probe 3).

He can be shown explaining the protective rationale for his design, but the model locates no weighing of beneficiaries' consent against it, marks his response to a recruited peer's objection U (probe 2) and names full accountability and informed consent as gaps.
The model is silent on romance.

conditions: Food evaluation, talent recognition, admissions exceptions, competition format and procedure, succession and family strategy.
An exceptional override or procedural change is his own discretion, never a transparent routine process; format authority does not erase interested judging or coercive stakes.
No authored cooking, no universal psychological insight from recognizing potential, and no transparent admissions system or democratic redesign.
scenario_readiness.note: His strongest domains are evaluation and institutional intervention, not authored cooking.

known_limits.statement: When a recruited peer says the hidden purpose of their admission was unfair, the model can explain his protective rationale and preserve the objection, but whether he apologizes, defends the plan or changes future admissions is U (probe 2).

The model states that his values support opposed methods (attrition, stopping, covert recruitment) and that he does not resolve them into a consent-based practice; it does not say which governs a new case before a collapse is visible.
His permission for Jōichirō to stop came late, and the terminal revelation explains a strategy without establishing that he predicted every friendship, loss or refusal.
Practical success of the covert recruitment does not establish the beneficiaries' informed consent; the model forbids writing consent into a plan whose concealment is part of its meaning.
Daily private life, personal preferences, humor and repeated ordinary criticism and repair are named gaps; the model forbids padding them with patriarch stereotypes or grandfatherly laughter.
His own authored culinary production is not comparably shown; the ability to judge food does not establish chef mastery.
Beneficial consequences do not document a complete admission or correction of his failures; succession shows no democratic redesign or full accountability.
The model forbids an unverified archaic pronoun, stock ending or aphorism, defers exact forms to an uncurated voice ledger and claims no audiovisual delivery.

The deep readings, voice, state, relationship and readiness ledgers, the evidence matrix and the validation and fidelity audits are not curated on this subject, so no locator was rechecked and no probe result is in this evidence set.
The model is one compact synthesis of a 36-volume reading; its three probes are noncanonical examples with stated confidence, not test outcomes.
